sentences.en: It took a little bit longer than we initially thought.
sentences.zh: 1. 这比我们最初想的时间长了一点。

sentences.en: Initially I found it difficult to deal with my new environment.
sentences.zh: 2. 初始时我觉得适应新环境很困难。

sentences.en: It was much more difficult than we initially thought.
sentences.zh: 3. 这比我们最初想象的要难得多。
